cn-jjj-sx-sd-p3-boda-0914-computing-conf.summary: Operator newsroom item dated 14 September 2026 (日期：2026-09-14) on Boda's participation in the 2026 China Computing Power Conference in Langfang (11-13 September). In its own words the company says that Langfang is an important node for it, that it currently has several projects there, and that its Langfang No. 2 intelligent computing base serves leading Internet enterprises with customised services (廊坊二号智算基地面向头部互联网企业提供定制化服务). In the same passage, its Langfang No. 1 base provides build-and-maintain services for JD.com, and further projects are being planned. The statement is present tense and names the Langfang No. 2 base, but no phase, building, capacity in use or opening day. Phase 2 of the base was still in pre-production validation on 9 October 2026 (existing Atlas record), so the services described on 14 September are those of the Phase 1 buildings, which the operator's 21 July 2026 WAIC item already describes as serving leading Internet clients.
